investments.title: ABC Jute Industries
investments.description: Eco-friendly biodegradable jute sack manufacturing plant modernising looms for export packaging supply. Established factory with 7-year profitable track record.
investments.terms: Quarterly interest disbursement with principal redemption at maturity (12 months). Security held in industrial weaving equipment pledge.

investments.title: Green Agro Hydroponics Hub
investments.description: Smart climate-controlled hydroponic farming producing pesticide-free exotic vegetables for premier supermarket chains across Western India.
investments.terms: Bi-monthly profit share distribution. 100% of greenhouse assets and solar pumping units hypothecated as collateral.

investments.title: VoltGrid Micro-Solar Stations
investments.description: Decentralized 50kW solar mini-grids powering rural commercial workshops and cold storage centers with 10-year PPA off-take agreements.
investments.terms: Government-backed PPA contract assignment with quarterly scheduled yields and asset buyback guarantee.

investments.title: Digital 24K Physical Gold Vault
investments.description: Securitized 99.9% fine LBMA-accredited gold bullion held in insured Brinks vaults. Admin updates real-time gram rate based on spot bullion market.
investments.expectedReturn: Bullion Spot Appreciation + Physical Delivery Option
investments.terms: 100% physically backed by insured vaults. User may hold or request liquidity redemption based on active daily bullion rates.

investments.title: Pure 999 Silver Reserve
investments.description: Institutional grade 99.9% fine silver bars stored in audited depository. Industrial green transition demands driving long-term value.
investments.terms: Audited monthly by independent chartered inspectors. Full custody certificates issued.

investments.terms: Fractional undivided share of land registered through SPV custodial deed with exit upon commercial development lease.
